audit_items.proof_trace: All oracle price access paths — get_price, get_price_with_check, and get_spot_price — unconditionally call check_price, which asserts age = clock.timestamp_ms() - last_updated*1000 <= price_delay_tolerance_ms before returning a price value. Both the borrow path (handle_borrow → is_obligation_safe → debts/collaterals_usd_non_liquidation → get_price_with_check) and the liquidation path (liquidation_inner → ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed → debts/collaterals_usd_for_liquidation → get_price; liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens → get_spot_price) route through check_price, so freshness is enforced on every price query. No raw price access bypasses this: market.move only imports these three functions from x_oracle::user_oracle (lines 13, 28).
